transcript:
Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Ravi ji? I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your back pain enquiry.
Customer: No, this is not Ravi. You have the wrong number.
Agent: Sorry sir, is anyone in your family looking for pain treatment?
Customer: No, nobody here made any enquiry. I don't know any Ravi. This number is mine for ten years.
Agent: Okay sir, sorry for the trouble.

Agent: Hello, I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic regarding your enquiry.
Customer: Hi, this is Priya from the CRM team. This lead was created by us as an internal test of the new form, it is not a real patient.
Agent: Oh okay, so no patient enquiry?
Customer: No, just testing the integration. You can close it.
Agent: Okay, noted. Thank you.

Agent: Hello, I am Neha from Aster Vale Pain Clinic. You enquired about knee pain treatment?
Customer: Yes, it is for my daughter. She has knee pain after playing.
Agent: How old is she, ma'am?
Customer: She is 12 years old.
Agent: Ma'am, our clinic only treats patients aged 15 and above, so we won't be able to take her case.
Customer: Oh, okay. Then it is only for her, nobody else needs it.
Agent: Okay ma'am, thank you.

Agent: Hello sir, I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your pain treatment enquiry.
Customer: Pain treatment? No, I was looking for a hair transplant clinic, I must have filled your form by mistake.
Agent: Do you or anyone at home have any pain, back pain, joint pain?
Customer: No, no pain at all. Nobody at home has any pain problem. I only wanted hair treatment.
Agent: Okay sir, sorry for the confusion.

Agent: Hello ma'am, I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your shoulder pain.
Customer: Yes, I had enquired.
Agent: Would you like to meet the doctor this week?
Customer: Not now, call me tomorrow evening.
Agent: Sure, I will call you tomorrow evening.
Customer: Actually no. I have already been called five times. Please remove my number from your list and do not call me again.
Agent: Okay ma'am, I will remove your number.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Pain Clinic here. You have lower back pain for six months?
Customer: Yes, it is quite bad. But I live far, can I consult online?
Agent: Yes sir, we have video consultations. The doctor has a slot tomorrow at 5 PM. Shall I book it?
Customer: Yes, book the video consultation for tomorrow at 5 PM.
Agent: Done sir, your online consultation is confirmed for tomorrow at 5 PM. I will send the link on WhatsApp.
Customer: Okay, confirmed. Thank you.

Agent: Hello ma'am, you had an appointment with Dr. Rao on Saturday for neck pain, but you could not come.
Customer: Yes, sorry, there was an emergency at home. I still want to meet the doctor.
Agent: No problem. Can I move your appointment to Friday at 11 AM?
Customer: Yes, Friday 11 AM is fine.
Agent: Okay ma'am, your appointment is rescheduled to Friday at 11 AM at the Oakfield clinic.
Customer: Okay, thank you, I will come.

Agent: Hello?
Agent: Hello, am I audible?
Customer: Hello... who...
Agent: I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic.
Customer: [inaudible]
Agent: Hello? Hello?

Agent: Hello sir, I am calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your knee pain enquiry.
Customer: Yes, but I live permanently in Dubai now. I filled the form while browsing.
Agent: Sir, you could visit when you come to India.
Customer: No, I am not coming to India at all, I have settled here.
Agent: We also offer online consultation with the doctor.
Customer: No, I don't want online consultation. I will get treated here in Dubai.
Agent: Okay sir, thank you.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Pain Clinic. You have heel pain for three months?
Customer: Yes, it is painful every morning. I want to meet the doctor, but I am travelling until next week.
Agent: The doctor is available on the 18th. Shall I book you on the 18th at 11 AM?
Customer: Yes, 18th at 11 AM is perfect, please book it.
Agent: Done ma'am, your clinic appointment is confirmed for the 18th at 11 AM.
Customer: Okay, thank you.
